svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: xournal-qt architecture
svg.desc: The layers of xournal-qt, from the QML UI down to the Xournal++ core it builds on, and the edges between their blocks. Generated from qt/docs/architecture/architecture.yaml.
svg.text: Dependencies point down. Opened on its own, each block links to its folder on GitHub. Generated from architecture.yaml.

g.title: The whole user interface, in QML: one window per Main.qml, its parts each in a file of its own. QML talks to C++ only through the context properties app (an AppController) and win, the types registered under XournalQt.Canvas, the image providers and the list models.
What the windows of the process share (AppServices), one window's QML API (AppController) and the program's start (main.cpp). Compiled into xqt-shell (the C++) and xournal-qt (main.cpp).

Everything between the documents and the QML that is not a canvas: the library, the tabs, what acts on a canvas, the image providers and their caches, the list and settings models. One target, xqt-shell.
A document shown in a view (canvas), the view in the Qt Quick scene graph (quick), and handwriting search (hwr), which reads the ink of the sessions.
One open document without a view (session), and what it builds on: the Markdown engine, recordings, and the Qt-free render workers. The CLI and the tests use these without a window.

Headers with upstream's names placed before upstream's include paths, so upstream's files compile without GTK and without edits: shadows of the GTK application classes (implemented by the fork), a GTK type shim, and GTK-free implementations of a few upstream files.

Upstream Xournal++'s C++ core, compiled unmodified (apart from the seams of ADR 0002) from the explicit list in qt/cmake/XojSources.cmake into three static libraries: xoj-util, xoj-core and xoj-tools. Upstream's GTK GUI is not built.
The headless CLI, the tests, the developer tools, the vendored libraries, the platform layers and CI.
The files both programs read and write. A document written by xournal-qt opens in Xournal++ and the other way round; the fork's own attributes are ones Xournal++ ignores.

path.title: Window → AppController (qml): every action and property through the context property app (QmlApiTest checks the names)
Canvas chrome → quick (qml): the DocumentCanvas item (import XournalQt.Canvas), AdaptiveLayout, TouchGestures
Canvas chrome → Pictures and caches (qml): image://thumbnail and image://sketch in the sidebar and page grid
Home and library → Library (qml): the library's list models (app.library, recent files, bookmarks, to-dos, tags)
Home and library → Pictures and caches (qml): image://cover, image://hitpage, image://mdsnippet
Settings → Models and settings (qml): SettingsModel, ShortcutsModel, ToolboxModel
main and EngineSetup → AppServices (calls): makes the services before the first window, drops them after the last
AppServices → AppController (calls): the window factory makes one AppController per window
AppServices → Library (calls): owns the library, its lists and the library's ink job
AppController → CurrentDocument (calls): follows the current tab
AppController → Tabs and canvas actions (calls): TabManager (its tabs), CanvasActions (app.edit), ReferenceMode, PresenterConsole
Tabs and canvas actions → canvas (links): xqt-shell links xqt-canvas: a tab owns its CanvasView, CanvasActions acts on one
Library → hwr (links): xqt-shell links xqt-hwr: LibraryInkJob reads the library's handwriting
quick → canvas (links): xqt-quick links xqt-canvas: DocumentCanvasItem shows a CanvasView and passes it all input
hwr → session (links): xqt-hwr links xqt-session: an indexer per open document reads its strokes
canvas → session (links): xqt-canvas links xqt-session: a view shows a session; edits go through its undo
canvas → render (calls): PageRaster per visible page, rendered by the RenderService's workers
canvas → Tools and handlers (links): xqt-canvas links xoj-tools: CanvasPage drives StrokeHandler, EraseHandler, EditSelection, the shape handlers
canvas → Shadow headers (shadows): CanvasPage implements XojPageView (gui/PageView.h); CanvasView implements XournalView and Layout; ViewController feeds ZoomControl
plugins → ops (links): xqt-plugins links xqt-ops: every API call is an operation checked for the plugin
ops → session (links): xqt-ops links xqt-session: operations act on a DocumentSession, a transaction is an UndoGathering
session → render (links): xqt-session links xoj-render: render workers in AppContext, drawing for exports
session → markdown (links): xqt-session links xqt-markdown: text documents, Markdown boxes in exports
session → audio (links): xqt-session links xqt-audio: recordings tied to elements
session → control/xojfile (calls): loads with LoadHandler and saves with SaveHandler (in the background, on a page copy)
session → model (calls): the Document it owns; listens to its changes
session → view (seam): StickyNote draws a note's layer (xoj::view::layerDrawer); PageMargins scales ruled paper (xoj::view::ruledScale)
session → Shadow headers (shadows): DocumentSession implements Control; HeadlessViews implement MainWindow, XournalView; SessionActions implements ActionDatabase
session → .xopp / .xoj files (data): opens and saves documents (atomically, through FileIo)
session → PDF files (data): annotates PDFs; writes the PDF with notes
markdown → model (seam): MdBox registers xoj::markdown::renderer, sizer and layoutPainter (model/MarkdownText.h), so Text and TextView draw Markdown
audio → model (calls): the ts/fn of strokes and texts, a page's voice memos; an undo action
render → view (calls): draws with DocumentView, LayerView and the background views, as upstream's RenderJob
render → pdf (calls): PDF backgrounds drawn outside the document lock (PdfCache, poppler)
Tools and handlers → Shadow headers (shadows): the handlers call Control, XojPageView, ZoomControl, … through the shadow headers
Shadow headers → GTK GUI (not built) (shadows): stand in for the GTK classes Control, MainWindow, XournalView, XojPageView, Layout (not built)
GTK-free sources → util (shadows): compiled into xoj-util in place of upstream's XojMsgBox.cpp and VersionInfo.cpp (DeviceId.cpp into xoj-tools)
GTK shim → GTK GUI (not built) (shadows): <gtk/gtk.h> and <gdk/gdk.h> of every xoj-* target resolve to the shim: GDK/GTK types without GTK
Tools and handlers → model (links): xoj-tools links xoj-core: the handlers make and change elements
model → util (links): xoj-core links xoj-util
control/xojfile → .xopp / .xoj files (data): the format's reader and writer
control → settings.xml (data): Settings reads and writes settings.xml

g.title: Window: The window (win): its state objects (insets, view modes, chrome layout), its keys with the one ordered Esc/Back dispatcher, and the parts it instantiates.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Canvas chrome: What surrounds the canvas: the tab strip, the toolbox and top bar, the pills over the page (selection, note, view), the page sidebar and the page area that hosts the DocumentCanvas item.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Home and library: The home screen: the library grid, recent files, bookmarks, to-dos and tags, the library's search and its file operations.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Settings: The settings page: one section per file (pen, touch, documents, display, search, storage, shortcuts, help) and the row types they are built of.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Dialogs and sheets: Dialogs, menus and sheets that adapt from a desktop window to a phone (a dialog on a desktop, a sheet from the bottom on a phone), and the dialogs built on them.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: main and EngineSetup: Starts the program: the platform's setup, the AppServices, the QML engine with its image providers and the context property app, then the main window from the QML module XournalQt.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: AppServices: One per process: owns AppContext, the library and its lists, the toolbox, shortcuts, handwriting search, the window factory, the open documents of every window and the background jobs quitting waits for.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: AppController: One window's QML API, the context property app: its tabs, the current document's properties and every action the UI offers; the App*.cpp files beside it hold one area each.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: CurrentDocument: The current tab's DocumentSession and CanvasView with their signals relayed in one place; a window follows a tab change with one call.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Tabs and canvas actions: The window's controllers: the tabs (each owns its session and view), what acts on one canvas, the reference view, version comparison, the presenter console, recovery after a crash.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Library: The library: a plain folder of documents, its index of every document's text and notes, its search, file operations, sharing and archives, and the list models of the home screen.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Pictures and caches: The QML image providers (thumbnails, sketches, covers, hit pages, snippets, annotation pictures), their caches with one owner of their memory and one owner of their worker threads.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Models and settings: The list models of one document (pages, outline, layers, annotations, versions) and the settings-like models (settings.xml's keys, shortcuts, the toolbox, palettes).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: quick: The bridge between a CanvasView and the Qt Quick scene graph: page tiles as scene graph nodes, an event filter that takes all canvas input, dark pages on the GPU, the window's size class.
g.text: the canvas in the scene graph

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: canvas: A DocumentSession shown in a view: the visible pages and their rendering, the input on them (pen, touch, mouse, palm rejection), and the tools and editors that work on a page. Qt Gui, no Qt Quick.
g.text: a document in a view; input, tools

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: hwr: Reads handwriting in the background (ONNX Runtime, loaded at run time) so the search finds it; the ink is never converted.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: audio: Records and plays Ogg Vorbis, compatible with Xournal++'s audio (a stroke tied to a moment of a recording).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: markdown: Parses (md4c), lays out (Pango), paginates and draws (cairo) Markdown text, with the same text stack as upstream's text elements; registers the renderer upstream's TextView asks for Markdown texts.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: session: One open document without a view: load, new, save in the background, autosave, undo, page revisions; the fork's formats (the PDF with notes, incremental saves, version history), search; process-wide AppContext.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: plugins: The plugins of the process: one QJSEngine per plugin with the frozen API module "xournal", commands run for a window as one transaction of the operations layer, permissions asked on first use, a watchdog (ADR 0008).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: ops: Every change a plugin (later a remote peer or an agent) makes to a document: an operation of the collaboration vocabulary, checked against what its principal may do, applied with undo, one undo step per transaction or rolled back (ADR 0008).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: render: Turns a page of upstream's model into pixels with upstream's views and cairo, on worker threads; Qt-free, so the CLI and the tests use it too.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: GTK-free sources: GTK-free implementations of a few upstream headers, compiled into xoj-util and xoj-tools instead of upstream's: message boxes through a pluggable sink (QML dialogs in the app, stderr in the CLI), the version, device identity.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Shadow headers: Headers with the path and API of upstream's GTK application classes (Control, MainWindow, XournalView, XojPageView, Layout, ZoomControl, ActionDatabase, LaserPointerHandler), abstract or GTK-free: the reused upstream code calls them, the fork implements them.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: GTK shim: Plain GDK/GTK types with GDK 3 values and pure-cairo helpers ported from GDK 3; any real GTK call in compiled upstream code is a compile error by design.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Tools and handlers: Upstream's input handlers (pen, eraser, shapes, spline, selection, PDF text selection) and the overlays that draw a stroke or a selection while it is made; compiled unmodified against the shadow headers.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: model: The document model: a document of pages of layers of elements (strokes, texts, images, TeX images, links), page backgrounds, the document lock and the listeners told of every change.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: control/xojfile: Reading and writing Xournal++'s files: the XML parser that builds a document, the save handler that writes one, gzip and attached backgrounds.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: view: Draws pages with cairo: a document, its layers and elements, the backgrounds (ruled, graph, PDF, image); what makes the fork's pixels identical to upstream's.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: pdf: Reading PDFs through poppler-glib (pages, text, links, outline) and exporting documents as PDF (cairo or qpdf backend).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: util: Upstream's utilities: paths (the config folder), colors, rectangles, gzip and zip streams, serializing, logging, and the UI-thread dispatch (a seam the fork sets).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: undo: Upstream's undo: one action class per kind of edit and the handler that stacks them; the fork adds its own actions of the same shape.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: control: The GTK-free parts of upstream's control layer: settings.xml, the tool in hand, page types, layers, the shape recogniser, the PDF page cache and the image export.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: GTK GUI (not built): Upstream's GTK application: the main window, page views, input handlers, dialogs, Control, the jobs and the plugins. Not compiled by the Qt build; qt/compat stands in for what reused code needs of it, and the fork ported a few classes (ADR 0002, "Ported, not reused").

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: CLI: Headless export with upstream's flags (PNG, SVG, PDF, the PDF with notes); the golden tests' driver.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Tests: One GoogleTest binary per module and label (unit session canvas markdown audio hwr quick shell ui), shared helpers, the UI fixture that drives the real window off-screen, the golden tests.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Upstream tests: Upstream's unit tests, run against the Qt-free core, and its fixtures (read only: tests never write into test/files).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Build and tools: The build (which upstream sources become which library), the environment and CI scripts, the upstream merge and developer tools.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Vendored libraries: Libraries compiled in: md4c and MicroTeX (Markdown), libogg and libvorbis (audio), ONNX Runtime's C headers (hwr), gemoji.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Linux: Desktop files, MIME types and the .deb package; the main platform.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Android: The APK: the manifest and Java activity, the setup before the core starts, Android's content:// files.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Windows: The portable zip: the setup before the core starts, Pango's fonts, the deployment.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: macOS: The unsigned .dmg: the bundle's Info.plist and the deployment.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: CI: The fork's workflows: the doc and architecture checks, both Linux Qt versions, the block tests in shards, the releases, the platform builds, this page on GitHub Pages.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Library folder: A plain folder of documents (synced by any sync client) with the library's index and covers in packs.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: Caches: Pictures of pages kept on disk (stand-ins, covers outside a library), autosaves; named by page revision.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: PDF files: PDFs annotated (as background) and the PDF with notes: the ink as annotations other apps show, the .xopp embedded, version history inside the file.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: .xopp / .xoj files: Xournal++'s documents (gzipped XML). Both programs read and write them; the fork's attributes (xqt-group, xqt-created, xqt-bookmark, xqt-fill-color, notespace) are ones Xournal++ ignores.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.title: settings.xml: Upstream's settings file, in a config folder of the fork's own (~/.config/xournal-qt); the fork's keys live in its custom part xournalQt.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
